description: Create a complete separate Flutter project at admin_app/ with package name com.rexo.admin. It includes: login with admin role gate, bottom nav (Dashboard/Users/Actions/Settings), and all admin screens (Dashboard, User Management, Campaign Control, Submission Review, Deposit Queue, Withdrawal Queue, Shop Admin, Disputes, KYC Verification, Wallets & Escrow, System Settings, Audit Logs, Push Broadcast, Rexo Program Review). Same premium UI style (white, orange-red accent #FF5722, Poppins font, Iconsax icons). Same Supabase connection via --dart-define.
steps: Create admin_app/pubspec.yaml with name: rexo_admin, same SDK constraint (>=3.2.0 <4.0.0), same dependencies as root pubspec.yaml (supabase_flutter: ^2.3.0, go_router: ^13.0.0, flutter_riverpod: ^2.4.0, google_fonts: ^6.1.0, cached_network_image: ^3.3.0, shimmer: ^3.0.0, flutter_animate: ^4.3.0, iconsax_flutter: ^1.0.0, intl: ^0.19.0, image_picker: ^1.0.0, url_launcher: ^6.2.0, shared_preferences: ^2.2.0, uuid: ^4.2.0). Same dev_dependencies. Same assets entries.
Create admin_app/analysis_options.yaml identical to root

Create admin_app/android/ structure: app/build.gradle with applicationId 'com.rexo.admin' and namespace 'com.rexo.admin', compileSdk 34, minSdk 21, targetSdk 34. Include settings.gradle, build.gradle (project-level), gradle.properties, gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties. Create app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml with INTERNET permission and proper application/activity setup for Flutter. Create app/src/main/kotlin/com/rexo/admin/MainActivity.kt extending FlutterActivity.
Create admin_app/assets/ directory with placeholder files (copy structure: assets/logo.png, assets/images/.gitkeep, assets/icons/.gitkeep)
Create admin_app/lib/core/constants/app_constants.dart - same pattern as root (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from String.fromEnvironment, adminEmail)
Create admin_app/lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart - identical to root
Create admin_app/lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart - identical to root
Create admin_app/lib/services/supabase_service.dart - identical to root (static methods for auth, user profile, etc.)

Create admin_app/lib/core/router/app_router.dart with go_router setup: routes for login, admin shell (bottom nav with 4 tabs: Dashboard, Users, Actions, Settings), and pushed screens for each admin sub-feature

Create admin_app/lib/core/widgets/ - app_shell.dart (with 4-tab bottom nav: Dashboard/Users/Actions/Settings using Iconsax icons), app_bottom_nav.dart (same floating pill style), premium_card.dart, shimmer_loading.dart, avatar_widget.dart, stat_chip.dart - same patterns as root
Create admin_app/lib/features/auth/providers/auth_provider.dart - same auth state management as root

Create admin_app/lib/features/auth/screens/login_screen.dart - login form with email/password, after successful auth: fetch user profile, check role == 'admin', if not admin show 'Access denied' dialog and sign out. Same premium UI styling.
Create admin_app/lib/features/auth/screens/splash_screen.dart - check auth state, navigate to login or dashboard
Create admin_app/lib/features/admin/providers/admin_provider.dart - same as the deleted root admin_provider.dart (all Supabase queries and CRUD operations)
Create admin_app/lib/features/dashboard/screens/dashboard_screen.dart - stats grid (total users, campaigns, revenue, pending items) using the adminStatsProvider pattern
Create admin_app/lib/features/users/screens/users_screen.dart - user management (list, verify, ban, suspend, role change) same as deleted admin_users_screen.dart

Create admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/actions_screen.dart - hub screen linking to Campaign Control, Submission Review, Deposit Queue, Withdrawal Queue, Shop Admin, Disputes, KYC Verification, Wallets & Escrow, Push Broadcast, Rexo Program Review
Create admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/campaign_control_screen.dart - list campaigns with pause/resume/force complete/cancel actions
Create admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/submission_review_screen.dart - pending submissions with approve/reject/disburse
Create admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/deposit_queue_screen.dart - pending deposits with approve/reject
Create admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/withdrawal_queue_screen.dart - pending withdrawals with approve/reject
Create admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/shop_admin_screen.dart - products CRUD, orders list
Create admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/disputes_screen.dart - investigation and resolution
Create admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/kyc_verification_screen.dart - approve/reject KYC documents
Create admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/wallets_escrow_screen.dart - overview, credit/debit wallets
Create admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/push_broadcast_screen.dart - send notifications to users
Create admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/rexo_program_screen.dart - review program applications
Create admin_app/lib/features/settings/screens/settings_screen.dart - system settings (commission %, maintenance mode) and audit logs
Create admin_app/lib/features/settings/screens/audit_logs_screen.dart - list audit logs
Create admin_app/lib/app.dart - RexoAdminApp with MaterialApp.router, same theme setup
Create admin_app/lib/main.dart - initialize Supabase, run ProviderScope with RexoAdminApp

Create admin_app/web/index.html (minimal) and admin_app/ios/ placeholder for completeness (at minimum ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj is not needed - just ensure Flutter can recognize it as a project)
acceptance_criteria: admin_app/ exists as a complete Flutter project with pubspec.yaml, android/, lib/
admin_app/lib/main.dart initializes Supabase and runs the admin app
Login screen checks role == 'admin' and rejects non-admin users
Bottom nav has 4 tabs: Dashboard, Users, Actions, Settings

All 14 admin screens are implemented (Dashboard, User Management, Campaign Control, Submission Review, Deposit Queue, Withdrawal Queue, Shop Admin, Disputes, KYC Verification, Wallets & Escrow, System Settings, Audit Logs, Push Broadcast, Rexo Program Review)
Same premium UI style - white background, orange-red accent, Poppins font, Iconsax icons
verification: Run: ls admin_app/pubspec.yaml admin_app/lib/main.dart admin_app/android/app/build.gradle - all should exist
Run: grep -r 'role.*admin' admin_app/lib/features/auth/ - should find the admin role check in login
findings: All 43 files created successfully for admin_app/. Verification passed: pubspec.yaml, main.dart, build.gradle all exist; applicationId is com.rexo.admin; admin role gate is implemented in auth_provider.dart with 3 checks. No build/test run due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - CI handles builds. Logo copied from main app assets.
